sentences.en: Local officials are twisting arms to push new development projects.
sentences.zh: 当地官员正在施压推动新的开发项目。

sentences.en: In a democracy, the people elect their government officials directly.
sentences.zh: 在民主制度下，人民直接选举政府官员。

sentences.en: Health officials have long urged people to eat less meat.
sentences.zh: 卫生部门的官员长期以来一直敦促人们减少肉类摄入。

senses.zh: 公务的, 公职的, 职权的 - 官方的, 正式的, 官方认可的
